title: Spectral memory kernels (distributed retention)

claims.text: Memory is not one universal retention scalar; it is a spectrum of kernels across decoders (classes, lanes, resolutions).
Clock (connect/Thalamus pulse) is not memory (filters/graph/cards) is not decision (Governor/immune/host).
Temporal decoding regimes map to Cortex as reset (ephemeral), integrate (connect/ranker/prefetch), retain (cards/canonical/hierarchy).
One task/connect broadcast is projected through many kernels; meaning is interaction of pulse geometry and decoder retention — never mutation rights.
Organism-like prune raises effective decay on reset weight; hierarchical retain and evidence rows are protected.

claim_boundary: Spectral packet teaches distributed retention architecture; not biology identity or host rights.
